behavior: Prepare snapshots original V2 source to user-v2-source.md and checks source spans before creating a campaign.
Open verifies cases/source digests and approved case IDs, budget configuration, existing ledger campaign, and setup-profile ownership marker.
A missing ledger is refused. Open never calls ledger.status and cannot recreate a missing ledger.
Repeated prepare retains campaign ID, config, and ledger bytes.
No symlink root, user alias parent, symlink file, or non-regular file is accepted. macOS system /tmp and /var aliases are canonicalized.
Price dates after the current instant and dates older than 24 hours are rejected. Price renewal changes no campaign price or ledger bytes.
Exclusive operation lock prevents setup/run overlap. Changed lock tokens are never removed.
notes: Only temporary qualification campaigns were created by tests and removed by afterEach. Real approved dataset/source were read-only.
Ledger semantic validation and accounting remain owned by AcceptanceBudgetLedger. Opening validates presence/shape/campaign and never writes that ledger.
